root_cause.text: The boundary check for 128-byte SQE operations in the SQE_MIXED path used the logical SQ head position (ctx->cached_sq_head) instead of the physical SQE index, allowing an unprivileged user to remap via sq_array a 128-byte operation to the last physical SQE slot, causing an out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `!(ctx->cached_sq_head & (ctx->sq_entries - 1))` with `(unsigned)(sqe - ctx->sq_sqes) >= ctx->sq_entries - 1` in io_uring/io_uring.c, and the CVE description states that "Setting sq_array[N] = sq_entries - 1 places a 128-byte operation at the last physical SQE slot, causing the 128-byte memcpy in io_uring_cmd_sqe_copy() to read 64 bytes past the end of the SQE array."
